name: investigate_feature
title: Investigate a feature
description: Trace a feature through relevant artifact, symbol, and function evidence while distinguishing observations, inferences, and residual unknowns.

arguments.name: feature
arguments.description: Feature, behavior, string, or symbol to investigate

arguments.name: target_path
arguments.description: Absolute target path; omit when the intended target is already open

arguments.name: document
arguments.description: Active target's provider document name

arguments.name: procedure
arguments.description: Known procedure name or address to prioritize

arguments.name: provider_id
arguments.description: Configured provider identity to prefer when its capability is available

name: compare_application_versions
title: Compare application versions
description: Compare two shipped application artifacts through complete inventory and optional static or runtime evidence without equating missing data with unchanged behavior.

arguments.name: left_target_path
arguments.description: Absolute path to the earlier or baseline target

arguments.name: right_target_path
arguments.description: Absolute path to the later or candidate target

arguments.name: left_manifest_id
arguments.description: Retained baseline artifact graph manifest to reuse or validate

arguments.name: right_manifest_id
arguments.description: Retained candidate artifact graph manifest to reuse or validate

arguments.name: focus_occurrence_id
arguments.description: Retained artifact occurrence to prioritize without authorizing extraction

name: verify_reconstruction
title: Verify a reconstruction
description: Evaluate a finite reconstruction specification against retained Evidence comparisons without broadening pass results into global equivalence claims.

arguments.name: reconstruction_goal
arguments.description: Finite behavior or structure the reconstruction is expected to satisfy

arguments.name: comparison_evidence_id
arguments.description: Retained comparison Evidence to use in a declared claim

arguments.name: provider_id
arguments.description: Provider identity whose Evidence is relevant to the reconstruction

name: trace_crash
title: Trace a crash
description: Correlate a crash symptom with static call and reference evidence plus optional process capture observations.

arguments.name: crash_signal
arguments.description: Crash message, exception, signal, address, or reproducible symptom

arguments.name: target_path
arguments.description: Absolute target path; omit when the intended target is already open

arguments.name: document
arguments.description: Active target's provider document name

arguments.name: procedure
arguments.description: Known crash-adjacent procedure name or address

arguments.name: capture_evidence_id
arguments.description: Retained process capture Evidence for the crash

name: audit_residual_unknowns
title: Audit residual unknowns
description: Review current residual-unknown heads against retained evidence, revision integrity, and declared authority without silently closing unanswered questions.

arguments.name: audit_scope
arguments.description: Decision, risk, or investigation scope the unknown audit must support

arguments.name: unknown_id
arguments.description: Active residual unknown to audit; omit to review every active head

arguments.name: evidence_id
arguments.description: Retained Evidence record relevant to the audit

name: prepare_bounded_process_capture
title: Prepare a bounded process capture
description: Choose a command, inputs, observations, and stopping conditions for a process capture that answers the behavioral question.

arguments.name: behavior_question
arguments.description: Behavioral question the capture must answer and stopping condition

arguments.name: executable
arguments.description: Command name or executable path requested for the scenario

arguments.name: working_directory
arguments.description: Working directory requested for the scenario

arguments.name: prior_capture_evidence_id
arguments.description: Retained process capture Evidence to compare or refine
